test_title: SSC CPO Tier-II Previous Year Paper (Held On: 26th July 2021)
subject: general
question: Select the most appropriate option to fill in the blank no. 10.
solution:
The correct answer is 'snatched.'

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The given sentence "***Before I could realize what she was up to, she ___(10)___ my purse and escaped***'' is telling something about** escaping with the purse**.
 
• The given sentence is talking about a past action.
 
• Therefore, the most appropriate word to be filled in the blank is 'snatched', a past tense form of the verb.
 
• The word 'snatched' means **to take something with a quick rough movement**. 
 
 
• Example:* The thief **snatched** her handbag and ran*.

 
 
 

Hence, the correct answer is option 4.

Complete Sentence: *Before I could realize what she was up to, she **snatched** my purse and escaped*.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Let us explore the other options:

__
 
• 'Was snatching' is the past continuous form of the verb. ('Was snatching' क्रिया का past continuous रूप है)
 
• 'Snatches' is the third-person present singular form of the verb. ('Snatches' क्रिया का third-person present singular रूप है)
 
• 'Snatch' is the root or base form of the verb. ('Snatch' क्रिया का root or base रूप है)

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/51867102c7c2f369f6e29d2efe025e3b3367c68261ec20262828d84ca5c8f854.png] **Hinglish__**

 
• दिया गया वाक्य "*Before I could realize what she was up to, she ___(10)___ my purse and escaped*'' पर्स के साथ भागने के बारे में कुछ बता रही है।
 
• दिया गया वाक्य **पिछली कार्रवाई के बारे में** बात कर रहा है।
 
• इसलिए, रिक्त स्थान में भरने के लिए सबसे उपयुक्त शब्द 'snatched' है, जो क्रिया का भूतकाल का रूप है।
 
• शब्द 'snatched' का अर्थ है **झपटा मारकर कुछ ले लेना; झपटना, छीनना**। 
 
 
• उदाहरण: *The thief snatched her handbag and ran*.
 
 

अत: सही उत्तर विकल्प 4 है ।

पूर्ण वाक्य: *Before I could realize what she was up to, she snatched my purse and escaped*.
